_comment: Acceptance fixture for the card-count gate. Q8 forbids committing lyrics,
so this stores a HASH of the pinned lyrics plus the derived expectations --
never the lyric text. The test fetches LRCLIB, verifies the hash still
matches, and asserts the counts below.
If the hash mismatches, LRCLIB's stored text changed: re-measure and update
this file deliberately. Do not weaken the gate.
_expected_notes_note: 148, not the 143 estimated during planning. 143 came from simplemma plus a
wordfreq proxy; the app resolves through the pack's own forms table, which
is a different lemmatizer. 148 was measured end to end against the built
pack and live LRCLIB, and every one of the 148 carries a non-empty English
gloss -- so the 'zero empty glosses' half of the done condition holds at
_unresolved_note: The 7 surfaces that resolve to no lemma are all non-Spanish: 4 ad-libs
(dididiri, fonsi, ohhh, woah) and 3 English loanwords (yeah, bang, daddy).
They are correctly absent from a Spanish vocabulary deck, so this list is
an assertion that the misses are the RIGHT misses -- if a real Spanish
word ever joins it, the pack regressed.
